title: decree plugin frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a plugin, .decree/plugins/<name>.md: one machine's folder, .decree/machines/<name>/, shared as one file: its machine, its scripts, its cron files, and seeds for its state/ and order/. The markdown body below the frontmatter tells a person what the plugin is for; decree keeps it as written. `decree install`, `add` and `import` install it: machine.yml, scripts/ and cron/ are the installed copy, never overwritten while edited in place; state/ and order/ are the project's, seeded once and never overwritten. `decree check` checks the rest: that every `needs` is in plugins/ (P2), that no plugin changed over an edited copy (P3), the installed machine itself (V1-V21), and the cron files as messages (M3). Reference: docs/reference/plugins.md.

name.description: The plugin's name: equal to the file's stem, plugins/<name>.md, and the name of the folder it installs, .decree/machines/<name>/ (P1).

needs.description: The other plugins this one relies on: each machine it invokes (`machine`), routes through (`router`, or the machine `router` a `model` state with no `router` uses) or emits to. Each must be in plugins/ (P2); `decree install` refuses a plugin whose needs are missing.

machine.description: The machine, as .decree/machines/<name>/machine.yml holds it, without `name`: the plugin's `name` names it. Installed with `name` first; machine.schema.json describes the rest. Optional: a plugin of scripts only is a library other plugins name in `needs` and source from .decree/machines/<name>/scripts/.

scripts.description: Every file of .decree/machines/<name>/scripts/, by its path there, to its text. A path is plain and relative: no `..`, `.`, empty parts or leading `/` (P1). An installed file is executable when its text starts with `#!`, and otherwise not. A file in scripts/ the plugin does not ship is removed when it is installed.

cron.description: Every cron file of .decree/machines/<name>/cron/, by its file name there (`<file>.md`), to its text: a cron file as messages.md describes it, with `cron:`, and `machine:` unless it runs this machine. Part of the installed copy, like scripts: a file in cron/ the plugin does not ship is removed when it is installed, an edit in place counts as an edit, and the folder goes with the plugin.

examples.weekly.md:
---
cron: 0 9 * * 1
machine: newsletter
---
This week's issue.

state.description: Seeds for .decree/machines/<name>/state/ ($DECREE_STATE_DIR), by path there, to its text. Each file is written only when absent and is never overwritten or removed: the state is the project's data. A file named `*.git.txt` is committed; any other is not.

order.description: Seeds for .decree/machines/<name>/order/, by file name there (`<file>.md`), to their text: messages the official `order` plugin runs in order at daemon start. Each is written only when absent and is never overwritten or removed: order/ is the project's, and committed.

examples.A01-newsletter-setup.md:
---
machine: newsletter
---
Create the subscriber list.

^x-.description: An extension, for a tool built on decree (existential's `x-exist-services`, say): decree reads none, and keeps them on export, as Compose and OpenAPI keep `x-` keys.
